source_selection.selection: Unused validation images with 2–8 annotated cartons. First 15 interior and first 5 boundary images sorted by SHA256(cbyp-holdout20-v1:ID). Boundary means an annotation bbox within 2% of image edge. Frozen before download or tested-model calls. No replacements. Interior is a metadata stratum, NOT a clean-delivery guarantee.
source_selection.scope: 20 distinct public photographs with authored notes/orders and synthetic speech. Not model-training holdout, field ground truth, SKU validation or labor-savings measurement. Visual references and targets to be frozen before model calls; uncertain images will not be forced into acceptance targets.

manifest.scope: POST-HOC geometry regression on the same 20 previously tested photos and exact valid fixtures, including the three already-frozen wrong-product addendum fixtures. Not a new holdout.
manifest.protocol: Exactly one new application run per unchanged valid fixture; same targets, orders, note/photo/audio bytes. No model-outcome edits or retries. Provider SDK transport retries unchanged. Every outcome retained. No ERP writer.
manifest.execution: All cbyp imports from isolated frozen runtime. No credentials copied. Three concurrent cases.

changes: All Spark and SAM image requests use EXIF-oriented, metadata-free lossless PNG pixels. Original files and their hashes remain unchanged. Corrects ambiguous encoded-vs-oriented image coordinates.
Spark point prompt no longer assumes ceiling view or regular grid; requires one interior-face point per actual carton.

Invalid point coordinates fail closed; ambiguous carton matches and duplicate probe IDs are not arbitrarily selected. Probe mask must contain its prompt point. Existing 80% containment / 1.5 growth / confidence thresholds unchanged.

Frame uses occupied mask extents instead of bounding-box padding. Empty/malformed/out-of-frame masks fail closed. Every actual boundary mask >=0.7, even tiny/doubtful, still requires review. 1% guard band unchanged.
Trace records point coordinates and per-point/probe associations for audit. No product, count, speech, visibility, audit, signoff or ERP policy relaxed.
